description: Update a task's title, description, priority or project. Only fields you pass change; status goes through taskhold_start, taskhold_complete and taskhold_block. Returns the task as it is now. Fails on an unknown task_id, a project_id that doesn't exist (pass project by name instead) or an invalid project name.

project.description: Project name, e.g. the repo folder ("api-server"). Move it to this project (matched case-insensitively, created on first use).

project_id.description: Move to project by id (null to remove)

task_id.description: The ID of the task to update

name: taskhold_update
title: Edit a task
